parameters.counting_rule: Zero daily bag and possession limit for trout at this water — Upper Otay Lake is managed as a Florida-strain largemouth bass fishery and is not stocked with trout; state regulation formally sets the trout take limit at zero. The reservoir operator additionally runs the lake as catch-and-release for all species.
